definitions.explanation: Someone who has a lot of money.

examples.japanese: お{金持|かねも}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{金持|かねも}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{生|う}まれた→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: She was born into a wealthy family.

examples.japanese: お{金持|かねも}ちだ⟦からといって→からといって：30623_karatoitte⟧、⟦{必|かなら}ずしも→必ずしも：03813_kanarazushimo⟧⟦{幸|しあわ}せ→幸せ：01420_shiawase⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{限|かぎ}らない→限る：02033_kagiru⟧。
examples.english: Being rich doesn't necessarily mean you're happy.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お{金持|かねも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→多い：01127_ooi⟧、⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦{並|なら}んでいる→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: There are many wealthy people in that town, and large houses line the streets.

notes:
お{金持|かねも}ち literally means 'money-haver.' The お prefix adds politeness.

FORMS:
- ⟦{金持|かねも}ち→金持ち：02993_kanemochi⟧: plain form (can sound blunt)
- お{金持|かねも}ち: softer, more common form

COMMON PATTERNS:
- お{金持|かねも}ち⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become rich
- お{金持|かねも}ち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧: a wealthy family/household
- {大|おお}{金持|かねも}ち: very rich person

SYNONYMS AND RELATED:
- ⟦{裕福|ゆうふく}→裕福：14041_yuufuku⟧な: wealthy (adjective, formal)
- ⟦{富豪|ふごう}→富豪：20556_fugou⟧: wealthy person, magnate (formal)
- ⟦{成金|なりきん}→成金：16724_narikin⟧: nouveau riche (often negative)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{貧乏|びんぼう}→貧乏：19466_binbou⟧: poor
- ⟦{貧乏人|びんぼうにん}→貧乏人：noentry⟧: poor person
